message.content:
Build the "Our Mission" page for the Boldteq marketing site.

**Project:** `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Marketing Site/Boldteq`
**Stack:** Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript strict, Tailwind 4, CSS Modules

**IMPORTANT:** Read CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md first. This project uses Next.js 16.2.3 — read `node_modules/next/dist/docs/` for any breaking changes. Never use `any` type. Read existing components first.

**Files to create:**

### 1. `src/app/our-mission/page.tsx` (server component)
Export metadata via `createMetadata` from `@/lib/seo/metadata`:
- title: "Our Mission | Boldteq"
- description: "Boldteq operates as your behind-the-scenes production team—delivering senior-level design and development under your brand, with structure, speed, and reliability."
- path: "/our-mission"

### 2. `src/components/our-mission/mission-hero.tsx` + `.module.css`
Hero banner with:
- Badge: "Our Mission" (gradient cyan text badge)
- H1: "The White-Label Delivery Partner Agencies Can Build On"
- Subtitle: "Boldteq operates as your behind-the-scenes production team—delivering senior-level design and development under your brand, with structure, speed, and reliability."
- 4 stat badges in grid: "White-Label by Default" (icon `/images/webflow/Layer_1-3.svg`), "Senior-Level Team" (`Layer_1-25.svg`), "Structured Delivery" (`Layer_1-22.svg`), "Agency-First Workflows" (`Layer_1-24.svg`)
- 2 CTA buttons: "Book a Demo" (link to /book-a-demo) + "Talk to Our Team" (link to /contact)
- Below: 2-column grid with navy background content:
  - Left column: heading "To help digital agencies scale faster without hiring pressure or delivery chaos." + paragraph about agencies struggling with delivery
  - Right column: heading "Why We Built Boldteq" + 2 paragraphs about agency growth challenges

### 3. `src/components/our-mission/delivery-standards.tsx` + `.module.css`
Section: "Our Delivery Standard"
- Badge: "Our Standard"
- Centered heading + subtitle: "Boldteq operates as a backend delivery system for agencies — built around consistency, control, and senior-level execution..."
- 4 cards in a grid:
  1. Icon: `/images/webflow/Layer_1-35.svg`, "Consistency", "Repeatable delivery systems ensure stable quality across every project..."
  2. Icon: `/images/webflow/Layer_1-34.svg`, "Speed With Control", "Fast turnaround backed by structure, communication, and internal review..."
  3. Icon: `/images/webflow/Layer_1-35.svg`, "Senior-Level Output", "Work executed by experienced professionals who understand agency expectations..."
  4. Icon: `/images/webflow/Layer_1-32.svg`, "White-Label by Default", "Your brand stays front-facing at all times..."

### 4. `src/components/our-mission/mission-delivery.tsx` + `.module.css`
Section: "How We Deliver On The Mission"
- 2-column layout (text left, image right):
- Left: Heading "How We Deliver On The Mission" + 5 bullet points (bold intro + description):
  1. "Dedicated delivery team aligned to your plan:" — "A consistent team that understands your workflows, priorities, and quality standards."
  2. "Structured task intake via Many Requests:" — "Clear scope, organized queues, and full visibility into active and upcoming work."
  3. "Slack-based communication for alignment:" — "Direct, real-time coordination to avoid delays, misinterpretation, or rework."
  4. "White-label–ready handoff for client delivery:" — "All outputs prepared for immediate client sharing under your branding."
  5. "Internal QA and review before completion:" — "Every deliverable is reviewed internally before it reaches your team."
  + "Book a Demo" button
- Right: Image `/images/webflow/Group-47036-1.png` (full width, with drop shadow)

### 5. `src/components/our-mission/mission-cta.tsx` + `.module.css`
Blue CTA section: "Ready to Deliver This Level of Work Under Your Brand?"
- Navy background (#082753)
- Title + subtitle: "Partner with Boldteq as your dedicated backend delivery team..."
- 3 benefits with blue tick icons (`/images/webflow/blue-tick.svg`): "Agencies with fluctuating demand", "Large monthly task volumes", "Multiple brands or clients"
- 2 buttons: "Book a Demo" (gradient) + "View Plans" (white outline, links to /pricing)

### Page composition:
```tsx
<MissionHero />
<DeliveryStandards />
<MissionDelivery />
<MissionCta />
```

**Key references to read first:**
- `src/app/page.tsx` — page composition pattern
- `src/components/shared/page-hero.tsx` — hero pattern
- `src/components/shared/section-wrapper.tsx` — section container
- `src/components/home/hero.tsx` + hero.module.css — for badge/banner styling
- `src/components/pricing/custom-plan-cta.tsx` — similar CTA pattern (navy bg + benefits)

**Styling:**
- CSS Modules for all components
- Brand colors: Navy (#082753), Cyan (#21cfff), Blue (#019ae6)
- Responsive: stack to single column on mobile
- The hero's 2-column grid should have semi-transparent navy background with white text
- The mission-delivery section image should have a subtle drop-shadow
